## Purpose and Repository Shape
This is a collection of reference tools, agents, and runnable samples for Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog: managing metadata as files, deploying semantic models, enriching documentation, and building AI-agent context. It is a multi-runtime repository rather than one application: TypeScript tooling is under `toolbox/`, Python agent examples under `okf/` and `samples/`, and Markdown bundles/model files are primary user-authored artifacts.

## Primary Entrypoints
- The `mdcode` CLI and MCP-facing tool are the main metadata-as-code surface: `toolbox/mdcode/src/tool/main.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/tool/commands.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/tool/mcp.ts`.
- The Python Reference Agent runs as a module/CLI: `okf/src/reference_agent/__main__.py`, `okf/src/reference_agent/cli.py`, `okf/src/reference_agent/runner.py`.
- A separate TypeScript enrichment agent is launched from `toolbox/enrichment/src/agent/main.ts` and orchestrated by `toolbox/enrichment/src/agent/enrich/command.ts`.
- Sample-specific scripts demonstrate standalone discovery and enrichment flows: `samples/discovery/agent.py`, `samples/enrichment/src/enrichment/enrich.py`.

## Metadata-as-Code Synchronization
`mdcode` treats filesystem layouts and manifests as a local representation of catalog content. Source adapters load remote or local objects, layouts map them to Markdown/file trees, and synchronization pushes or pulls changes.
- Source abstraction and adapters: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/source.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/sources/bq-dataset.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/sources/kb.ts`.
- Layout and manifest boundary: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/layout.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/layouts/documents.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/manifest.ts`.
- Change orchestration and persisted state: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/sync.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/snapshot.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/metadata.ts`.

## Semantic-Model Pipeline
The semantic-model subsystem loads declarative models, resolves inheritance/profile bindings, validates them, and converts/deploys them to backend-specific representations. Its central intermediate representation separates modeling semantics from deployment targets.
- Loading, normalization, and validation: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/loader.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/resolve_inheritance.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/validate.ts`.
- Model IR and bindings: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/ir.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/binding.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/resolve_profiles.ts`.
- Output conversion/deployment: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/deploy_bigquery.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/deploy_knowledge_catalog.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/deploy_spanner.ts`.
- Interoperability includes OSI and OWL import/export paths: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/osi_converter.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/converters/owl/convert.ts`.

## Runtime and Cloud Boundaries
The TypeScript implementation integrates with Google Cloud APIs for Knowledge Catalog/Dataplex, BigQuery, Spanner, AlloyDB, Gemini, and CRM. Semantic runtime facilities execute actions, enforce guards/constraints, choose SQL dialects, and persist execution/judgment state.
- Cloud client boundary: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/gcp/api.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/gcp/dataplex.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/gcp/bigquery.ts`.
- Agent/action runtime: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/runtime/runtime.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/runtime/run_action.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/runtime/agent_tools.ts`.
- SQL generation/transpilation boundary: `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/bigquery.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/spanner.ts`, `toolbox/mdcode/src/libts/semantic/transpile.ts`.

## Reference-Agent and Bundle Generation
The Python Reference Agent synthesizes navigable Markdown knowledge bundles from data sources and web content. It exposes source, bundle, context, and web capabilities as agent tools; generated indexes and visualization assets make resulting bundles consumable by humans or agents.
- Agent/control layer: `okf/src/reference_agent/agent.py`, `okf/src/reference_agent/tools/source_tools.py`, `okf/src/reference_agent/tools/bundle_tools.py`.
- Bundle document/index/synthesis boundary: `okf/src/reference_agent/bundle/document.py`, `okf/src/reference_agent/bundle/index.py`, `okf/src/reference_agent/bundle/synthesizer.py`.
- External ingestion is BigQuery plus web fetching: `okf/src/reference_agent/sources/bigquery.py`, `okf/src/reference_agent/web/fetcher.py`.
- Representative generated bundles: `okf/bundles/ga4/`, `okf/bundles/crypto_bitcoin/`, `okf/bundles/acme_retail/`.

## Enrichment Pattern and Samples
The enrichment implementations use an agent to inspect source metadata/documents, generate or patch Markdown context, and publish results. Python and TypeScript variants demonstrate the same architectural concern independently; the latter includes an MCP Markdown/fileset server.
- Python enrichment pipeline: `samples/enrichment/src/enrichment/download.py`, `samples/enrichment/src/enrichment/enrich.py`, `samples/enrichment/src/enrichment/publish.py`.
- TypeScript agent and Markdown tools: `toolbox/enrichment/src/agent/enrich/agent.ts`, `toolbox/enrichment/src/tools/md/server.ts`, `toolbox/enrichment/src/tools/md/fileset.ts`.
